items.html: And the matter is, that each one of the aforementioned original and fundamental ten Sefirot includes ten, for everything that is called a head is included of ten. And the upper head has already been explained to be called Atik Yomin, and is included of ten. However, the nine other Sefirot are divided in this manner: their KHB are the three heads of Atik, which is AA; and their HGT are the three heads of ZA; and their NHY are the three heads of the Nukva of ZA. And this matter you will understand from what I have taught you, that the three Mochin of the Nukva of ZA are the aspect of NHY. And understand this very much.
